correctness.rationale: Reconstructed all quantifiers and hull boundaries: star closure identity; cyclic complete-bipartite mixed triple hulls all vertices; three-part mixed pair hulls all vertices. Verified equivalence of each of three independence predicates for the precise classified sets and polynomial coefficients. Quotient by disjoint pure-part simplices is homotopy preserving, giving connected 1D graph or simply connected 2D CW; Euler characteristic gives integer wedge ranks. Small-order exhaustive predicate and GF2 homology checks corroborate but do not establish infinite/integral statements.

value.rationale: A single exact common simplicial complex resolves three distinct cycle-convexity independence notions on all connected complete multipartite graphs and supplies full face enumeration and integral homotopy type, with a structural jump from 2-sphere wedges (cyclic bipartite) to circle wedges (three-or-more parts). This is not merely the known maximum Carathéodory number or known dissociation polynomial.
